subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI messages can reach shared context but still not appear in Open WebUI visible chat history

question: Should OpenClaw own syncing external Control UI turns into Open WebUI's visible history store, and if so through which supported boundary?
rationale: The remaining behavior is not a narrow code bug until maintainers decide whether direct external SQLite writes, an Open WebUI API/extension path, opt-in operator configuration, and historical backfill are acceptable OpenClaw responsibilities.

options.title: Implement opt-in visible-history sync
options.body: Add a documented, operator-enabled Open WebUI sync path with schema/API version handling, fresh-turn tests, and Docker/Open WebUI proof.

options.title: Document unsupported co-editing
options.body: Keep OpenClaw transcript/model context as the source OpenClaw owns and document that Open WebUI's visible history is not updated by Control UI sends.

options.title: Defer to a plugin or integration
options.body: Keep core unchanged unless a plugin/API extension is needed to support this external sync safely.

recommendation.title: Implement opt-in visible-history sync
recommendation.body: Add a documented, operator-enabled Open WebUI sync path with schema/API version handling, fresh-turn tests, and Docker/Open WebUI proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The current Gateway chat/session path and recent adjacent history point to steipete as the best available routing owner for the product boundary decision.
